sloka: विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीत् वाक्यम् शृणु येन बलोत्कटा ।वर दान कृतम् वीर्यम् धारयति अबला बलम् ॥१-२५-४॥
transliteration: viśvāmitro'bravīt vākyam śṛṇu yena balotkaṭā ।vara dāna kṛtam vīryam dhārayati abalā balam ॥1-25-4॥

translations.english: "In the past there was a powerful and great yaksha by name Suketu. He had no children. So he performed an intense penance following virtuous practices.
